user.title: Connect to your Freebox Player
user.description:
This integration fully remote-controls a Freebox Player (Revolution/Delta/Crystal/mini4K) over the network, using Free's own Foils HID protocol -- the same one used by the official Android remote app. Unlike the HTTP remote-control API, it also covers navigation, power, colors, the numeric keypad and channel change.

![Freebox Player Revolution remote layout](/freebox_player_remote/logo.png)

Find the Player's IP address in the Freebox OS web interface (mafreebox.freebox.fr) under Réglages > Freebox Player, or in your router/DHCP client list. **We strongly recommend setting a DHCP reservation for the Player on your Freebox** so its IP never changes -- otherwise this integration will stop working the next time the Player gets a new address.

data_description.host: IPv4 address of the Freebox Player on your local network, e.g. 192.168.1.10.
data_description.port: Leave empty to let Home Assistant discover the Foils HID port automatically via mDNS. Only fill this in if automatic discovery fails; you can find it with a tool like 'avahi-browse -r _hid._udp' on your network.

error.invalid_host: This is not a valid IPv4 address (e.g. 192.168.1.10).
error.cannot_connect: The host could not be reached (network unreachable / no route to host). Check the IP address and that the Player is on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.connection_refused: The connection was actively refused by the host. Check the port, and that the Player's network remote-control feature is enabled.
error.timeout_connect: No response from the Freebox Player within the timeout. Check that it is powered on, and that the IP/port are correct.
error.discovery_failed: No port was given and automatic discovery (mDNS) did not find the Foils HID service. Enter the port manually.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while testing the connection. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Freebox Player is already configured.

press.name: Press remote key
press.description: Sends a single remote-control key press (press + release) to a Freebox Player over the Foils HID network protocol.

key.name: Key
key.description: Name of the remote control key to send, matching the buttons on the physical Freebox Player Revolution remote.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one Freebox Player HID device is configured.
